A few things
to know first.

Does the firm handle my type of matter?+

The firm lists business law, commercial litigation, credit-union counsel, real property, estate planning, probate and alternative dispute resolution among its practices. Call to discuss fit for your particular situation.

What should I share when I first reach out?+

Start with the general nature of the matter and any deadline. Do not send confidential or time-sensitive information through a website form.

What does a consultation cost?+

Contact the office to confirm consultation availability, any fee and the process before you schedule.

Where is the office?+

The firm is in the Barrister Building, Suite 550, at 155 E. Market Street in downtown Indianapolis. Call ahead to arrange a visit.
